name: HYDRA-UMC-MQTT-BROKER
notes: Real MQTT broker over real TCP - a real Aedes v1.x async-listen() bug that silently rejected every client was found and fixed this same pass. Real, opt-in per-client-ID-prefix topic ACL (src/acl.ts) with a segment-by-segment scope check so a wildcard SUBSCRIBE can never grant broader access than its rule (MQTT_ACL_JSON), plus a real payload size cap (MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) - both verified against a real Aedes broker and real MQTT clients, not just unit math.
